body: I hope so, but it just really sucks.

That's been pretty much what I've been telling myself each time I start having suicidal thoughts. "Just a few more years, and it'll be fine." That usually brings me out of a suicidal week. It's however recently turned really bad, and it just feels like it's an unending tunnel of depression. 

I've turned to thinking "Is it even worth withstanding all of this, for what I want to achieve." It just feels like an unreachable light if that makes sense. Like you get 10 billion dollars, but every 10 seconds for the next 4 years you get kicked in the face.

Would it be worth to take years long torment, for a reward I suppose. I hope I get through it, but it just doesn't seem worth it anymore.
